_doc: Deterministic intent->label mapping for the AE-3 intent-lexicon baseline. Ordered list; first regex match wins. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regex on the command text. The chosen target_label is then fed to the same template grounder that handles explicit spatial commands.

rules.pattern: throw (away|out)|dispose|recycle|waste|garbage|where (the )?trash goes|trash bin|trash can|put this trash
rules.label: trash bin

rules.pattern: leave (the )?room|room exit|way out|take me to the exit|the exit
rules.label: door

rules.pattern: tired|let me rest|take a rest|have a rest
rules.label: bench

rules.pattern: sit on|need a chair|place to sit|chair to sit
rules.label: chair
